## Instagram outage reason: Why DMs are not working [...] ## Instagram outage reason: Why DMs are not working

While Instagram has not disclosed the exact technical reason for the outage, reports indicate that the disruption mainly affected the direct messaging system.Problems with connecting to the server made the app slow down, which made it hard for users to load their feeds or send messages. Downdetector, the service that tracks outages, confirmed that complaints started to rise quickly in the evening, which means there was a widespread technical failure.Instagram acknowledged the issue, stating, “We are aware some of you might be experiencing issues with IG at the moment. We’re working to get things back to normal as quickly as possible.”

### Users' reaction to Instagram down reports [...] Representative Image

A widespread outage on Instagram made it impossible for thousands of people in the US to send or receive direct messages (DMs). The Meta-owned platform, which many people use for both personal and business reasons, saw an unprecedented rise in reports of service outages. People in big cities like Los Angeles, Phoenix, Chicago, Washington D.C., and New York said they had trouble using the messaging feature. Many people were still able to see public posts and stories, but the fact that they couldn't use DMs made everyday users, content creators, and business accounts who rely on the app for private communication very angry.Downdetector kept track of the outage and reported more than 6,000 problems with Instagram as of late evening.
